coatings.name: MGF2_QW550
coatings.description: Single quarter-wave MgF₂ film at 550 nm: R ≈ 1.3 % on N-BK7, the classic single-layer AR

coatings.name: VCOAT_355
coatings.description: V-coat for 355 nm: MgF₂ 82.1 nm over Ta₂O₅ 8.5 nm (not quarter waves), zero reflectance at the laser line on N-BK7

coatings.name: VCOAT_532
coatings.description: V-coat for 532 nm: MgF₂ 123.1 nm over Ta₂O₅ 15.4 nm (not quarter waves), zero reflectance at the laser line on N-BK7

coatings.name: VCOAT_550
coatings.description: V-coat for 550 nm: MgF₂ 127.2 nm over Ta₂O₅ 16.1 nm (not quarter waves), zero reflectance at the laser line on N-BK7

coatings.name: VCOAT_633
coatings.description: V-coat for 633 nm: MgF₂ 146.5 nm over Ta₂O₅ 19.0 nm (not quarter waves), zero reflectance at the laser line on N-BK7

coatings.name: VCOAT_1064
coatings.description: V-coat for 1064 nm: MgF₂ 246.6 nm over Ta₂O₅ 33.7 nm (not quarter waves), zero reflectance at the laser line on N-BK7

coatings.name: VCOAT_1550
coatings.description: V-coat for 1550 nm: MgF₂ 360.4 nm over Ta₂O₅ 49.3 nm (not quarter waves), zero reflectance at the laser line on N-BK7

coatings.name: BBAR_VIS
coatings.description: Broadband antireflection for the visible (420–680 nm), 6 layers Ta₂O₅ / MgF₂: R < 0.6 % across the band

coatings.name: BBAR_NIR
coatings.description: Broadband antireflection for the near infrared (650–1050 nm), 6 layers Ta₂O₅ / MgF₂: R < 0.6 % across the band

coatings.name: BBAR_SWIR
coatings.description: Broadband antireflection for the short-wave infrared (1000–1650 nm), 6 layers Ta₂O₅ / MgF₂: R < 0.6 % across the band

coatings.name: HR_532
coatings.description: Dielectric high reflector at 532 nm, normal incidence: (HL)^12 H quarter waves TiO₂ / SiO₂, R > 99.9 %

coatings.name: HR_633
coatings.description: Dielectric high reflector at 633 nm, normal incidence: (HL)^12 H quarter waves TiO₂ / SiO₂, R > 99.9 %

coatings.name: HR_1064
coatings.description: Dielectric high reflector at 1064 nm, normal incidence: (HL)^12 H quarter waves TiO₂ / SiO₂, R > 99.9 %

coatings.name: HR_1550
coatings.description: Dielectric high reflector at 1550 nm, normal incidence: (HL)^12 H quarter waves TiO₂ / SiO₂, R > 99.9 %

coatings.name: HR_1064_45
coatings.description: Dielectric high reflector at 1064 nm for 45° (both polarisations): (HL)^14 H TiO₂ / SiO₂ quarter waves at 45°

coatings.name: AL_PROTECTED
coatings.description: Protected aluminium: 100 nm Al under a half-wave SiO₂ overcoat at 550 nm (absentee there); R ≥ 85 % from 420 to 700 nm

coatings.name: AL_ENHANCED
coatings.description: Enhanced aluminium: 100 nm Al with (L H)² quarter waves of SiO₂ / TiO₂ at 550 nm; R ≥ 95 % from 480 to 620 nm

coatings.name: AL_UV
coatings.description: UV-enhanced aluminium: 100 nm Al with 25 nm MgF₂ (the classic UV overcoat); R ≥ 85 % from 200 to 400 nm

coatings.name: AG_PROTECTED
coatings.description: Protected silver: 150 nm Ag under 119 nm Al₂O₃; R ≥ 95 % from 450 to 1900 nm (Ag data end at 1.94 µm)

coatings.name: AU_PROTECTED
coatings.description: Protected gold: 150 nm Au under 40 nm SiO₂; R ≥ 95 % from 700 to 1900 nm (Au data end at 1.94 µm)

coatings.name: HOT_MIRROR
coatings.description: Hot mirror (0°): transmits the visible (420–650 nm) and reflects the near infrared (750–1100 nm); TiO₂ / SiO₂

coatings.name: COLD_MIRROR
coatings.description: Cold mirror (0°): reflects the visible (430–640 nm) and transmits the near infrared (760–1100 nm); TiO₂ / SiO₂

coatings.name: LP_550
coatings.description: Long-pass edge filter at 550 nm (0°), TiO₂ / SiO₂: blocks below 1 % and passes above 93 % 25 nm from the edge

coatings.name: SP_550
coatings.description: Short-pass edge filter at 550 nm (0°), TiO₂ / SiO₂: blocks below 1 % and passes above 93 % 25 nm from the edge

coatings.name: BP_532
coatings.description: Band-pass at 532 nm (0°): two-cavity Fabry–Perot of TiO₂ / SiO₂ quarter waves (HL)³H 2L (LH)³ L (HL)³H 2L (LH)³, FWHM ≈ 4 nm, blocking < 1 % beyond ±8 nm

coatings.name: NOTCH_532
coatings.description: Notch (band-block) at 532 nm: (HL)^40 H quarter waves of the low-contrast pair Al₂O₃ / SiO₂, a narrow stop band (T < 1 %); the pass bands ripple (T > 70 % from 450 to 490 nm)

coatings.name: BS_50_45
coatings.description: Plate beam splitter at 45° (unpolarised mean R 50 ± 10 %) for 450–650 nm, Ta₂O₅ / SiO₂

coatings.name: PBS_MACNEILLE
coatings.description: MacNeille polarising beam-splitter cube (45° in glass n 1.7657): every TiO₂ / SiO₂ interface at Brewster's angle for p at 550 nm, so p is transmitted and s reflected

coatings.name: DM_800
coatings.description: Dispersive (chirped) mirror for 800 nm ultrafast pulses: R ≥ 99 % over 760–840 nm and GDD −40 ± 15 fs² per bounce over 770–830 nm, 24 TiO₂ / SiO₂ layers refined from a linearly chirped quarter-wave stack
